method: Installed signed release APK. Actual Android touchscreen events via the dedicated emulator ADB transport; visual review of Android screencaps. No app save or JavaScript state injected in the native puzzle test.

passed.check: Release 0.3.1 opens on Android 15 after update installation
System status/navigation bars no longer overlap the header and fixed bottom navigation
Two already placed pieces preserved when updating from 0.3.0 to 0.3.1
Actual tap/drag placement and rejection of an incorrect target
24-piece level 1 completed and Akbar discovery card displayed
After level 1: level 2 and connection 1–2 visible, level 3 remains hidden
Museum collection screen renders with bottom tabs above Android navigation

fix.description: Apply Android window insets to an outer FrameLayout, resizing the actual WebView viewport so fixed HTML controls remain inside the available screen.

remaining_native_checks: Open earned card from museum and return with Android Back
Settings, English language switch, help/privacy/ad-free/restore sheets
Fresh relaunch persistence after first-level completion
Soft keyboard, rotation and gesture-navigation layout
covered_in_browser_only: Partial-save reload, legacy-save migration, reset confirmation
limitations: Native log records emulator shutdown before remaining checks; no current live emulator at the time of evidence review
A museum scroll position observed while the user was interacting was not reproduced in isolation; no app defect established
